from: June book, night 8 (We Want a King!)
p1: Samuel was now old. For many years, he had taught the people what Heavenly Father said.
One day the leaders of Israel came to him. They said, “Give us a king, like all the other lands have.”
This made Samuel sad. So Samuel prayed to the Lord about it.
p2: The Lord said, “They have not turned away from you. They have turned away from Me, their King.” The Lord was Jesus, and He was already their King! Still the people said, “We want a king!” So the Lord said, “Make them a king.”
When Samuel felt sad, he prayed. Tonight, you can tell Heavenly Father anything that makes you sad. Jesus is your King, and He will always take care of you.
old: The prophet Samuel was getting old. He had been Israel’s leader for a long time. The people came to Samuel and said, “We want a king like all the other nations have!”
Samuel felt sad. He prayed to Heavenly Father. God said, “The people aren’t rejecting you, Samuel. They’re rejecting ME as their king.”
Samuel warned the people: “A king will take your sons for his army. He’ll take your daughters to work for him. He’ll take your best fields and animals.” But the people said, “We still want a king!”
Sometimes we want things just because others have them. But Heavenly Father knows what’s best for us. The Israelites learned this the hard way.
